U_0x0014C2.en: Unit 3 of the R Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-3 POWERED." A light command-use, long-range <Personal Trooper> with <T-LINK System>-based remote weapons and superb detection and intel gathering. Only Psychodrivers can pilot it; in practice it is Capt. Aya Kobayashi's machine. Plus parts with a T-LINK Flight System make it the heavy bomber R-3 Powered.

U_0x001802.en: Unit 1 of the RW Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-GUN." Originally a high-output heavy metal particle cannon, it was miniaturized for a certain purpose and given a <Personal Trooper> transformation so it could fight on its own. Its new <Tronium> Engine exceeds R-2's, with output and firepower above the other R Series, though extremely unstable. Effectively the fourth R Series unit but never named "R-4," it was developed in secret at <Mao Industries> on the Moon under the codename "ARGAN." With plus parts like the back-mounted High Twin Launcher it becomes R-GUN Powered. After the <L5 Campaign>, the improved <T-LINK System> enabled T-LINK Twin Contact with R-3.

U_0x001D49.en: A prototype all-purpose decisive-strike <Personal Trooper> of the <SRX Project>, formed from R-1, R-2 Powered, and R-3 Powered. Officially "SUPER ROBOT X-TYPE." Its concept: "a humanoid weapon combining the traits of a special humanoid mobile weapon (<S.Unit>/Super Robot) and a <Personal Trooper>, able to change the course of battle as one unit or three separate machines." The <SRX Project> positioned it as a combiner in which three 20-meter-class <Personal Trooper>s unite into a 50-meter-class <S.Unit>. Separating or combining to suit the situation gives flexibility: against many weaker foes, or when coordinating with other <Personal Trooper>s, the units act separately; against a few powerful foes they combine to concentrate the R Series' strength. Its attack power is superb, but the <Tronium> Engine is hard to regulate, and in combat a Telekinetic Field must stay deployed via the <T-LINK System> to hold the combined state, straining its user severely; this limits combinations per sortie and combat time.

U_0x0045EE.en: A humanoid mobile weapon of the Machinery Children. A Mass-Prod Huckebein Mk-II remade with <Machine Cell> for new form and higher specs. Mounts the <Geim System> and remote weapons; its <Machine Cell> frame self-repairs.

U_0x0047B4.en: A special anti-alien humanoid mobile weapon developed by the <Tesla Leicht Institute> for the Earth Sphere Defense Committee. Built around physical attack by sheer mass, its size and shape are meant to intimidate intelligent foes. Designed to fight powerful enemies beyond a <Personal Trooper>, it boasts exceptional output and attack power. Its huge blade, the "Type-0 Zankantou," can cleave battleship-class objects in two. High-thrust boosters and trim balancers on its back enable free-ranging sword combat, and its TGC joints cut load by controlling inertial mass via gravity control. After the <Inspector Incident>, a refit gave it a plasma reactor.

U_0x0054BB.en: Third unit (SRG-03-3) of the newest Grungusts, from the <Tesla Leicht Institute> under the <SRX Project>, unfrozen after the <L5 Campaign>. Based on the Grungust (Type-1) and specialized for melee, it has the series' highest output and attack power. It splits into the G-Raptor fighter (upper body) and G-Bison tank (lower body), one pilot in each. After the <Inspector Incident>, it gained the <T-LINK System>, a <Tesla Drive>, and the Type-3 Shishioh Blade (<S.Unit>-size).

U_0x007810.en: A <Personal Trooper> developed by <Mao Industries>. A close-combat unit inheriting the Alt Eisen's concept, usually deployed with the artillery-type Wild Falken. It uses no <EOT>, carrying solid-round short/mid-range weapons, and uses the GII frame rather than the R-1/Huckebein H frame. A high-output <Tesla Drive> permits solo flight under gravity; purging its Jacket Armor shifts it to high-mobility mode. Designed by Dr. Marion Radom. One other unit of the type exists.

U_0x00827E.en:
The R-Blade is <Mao Industries>' simplified mass-production prototype <Personal Trooper> based on the R-1. It omits the R-1's flight transformation and <T-LINK System> (telekinesis sensor-amplifier) but performs well.
The R-Blade Custom refits prototype 3 for close combat, adding a <Tesla Drive>, Split Beam Cannon, and the Wild Wurger's jacket armor.
